prompt.en: Which long, curved fruit usually has yellow skin when ripe?
prompt.fr: Quel fruit long et courbé a généralement la peau jaune à maturité ?
prompt.tl: Anong mahaba at kurbadong prutas ang karaniwang dilaw kapag hinog?

prompt.en: Which tropical fruit has a rough skin and a crown of pointed leaves?
prompt.fr: Quel fruit tropical a une peau rugueuse et une couronne de feuilles pointues ?
prompt.tl: Anong tropikal na prutas ang may magaspang na balat at koronang matutulis na dahon?

prompt.en: Which fruit has a large flat stone and orange flesh, and is famously grown in Guimaras?
prompt.fr: Quel fruit à noyau plat et à chair orangée est notamment cultivé à Guimaras ?
prompt.tl: Anong prutas na may malaking patag na buto at kahel na laman ang tanyag sa Guimaras?

prompt.en: Which large fruit usually has green skin, red flesh and many black seeds?
prompt.fr: Quel gros fruit a généralement une peau verte, une chair rouge et de nombreux pépins noirs ?
prompt.tl: Anong malaking prutas ang karaniwang may berdeng balat, pulang laman at maraming itim na buto?

prompt.en: Which small fruit grows in bunches and is dried to make raisins?
prompt.fr: Quel petit fruit pousse en grappes et se sèche pour devenir un raisin sec ?
prompt.tl: Anong maliit na prutas na kumpol-kumpol ang pinatutuyo upang gawing pasas?

prompt.en: Which fruit has a hard fibrous shell, white flesh and water inside?
prompt.fr: Quel fruit a une coque fibreuse dure, une chair blanche et de l’eau à l’intérieur ?
prompt.tl: Anong prutas ang may matigas na mabuhok na bao, puting laman at tubig sa loob?

prompt.en: Which sour yellow citrus fruit is commonly squeezed into lemonade?
prompt.fr: Quel agrume jaune et acide presse-t-on pour faire de la citronnade ?
prompt.tl: Anong maasim at dilaw na citrus ang pinipiga para gumawa ng lemonade?

prompt.en: Which red fruit has tiny seed-like dots on its surface and a green leafy top?
prompt.fr: Quel fruit rouge porte de petits points semblables à des graines sur sa surface et une collerette verte ?
prompt.tl: Anong pulang prutas ang may maliliit na tuldok na parang buto sa labas at berdeng dahon sa itaas?

prompt.en: Which creamy green fruit has one large round stone and is used for guacamole?
prompt.fr: Quel fruit crémeux et vert a un gros noyau rond et sert à préparer le guacamole ?
prompt.tl: Anong kremang berdeng prutas na may malaking bilog na buto ang ginagamit sa guacamole?

prompt.en: Which tropical fruit has orange flesh and a central cavity full of small black seeds?
prompt.fr: Quel fruit tropical a une chair orange et une cavité remplie de petits pépins noirs ?
prompt.tl: Anong tropikal na prutas ang may kahel na laman at gitnang puno ng maliliit na itim na buto?
